description: This file appears to be a test script written in Shell that verifies the compatibility and correctness of reftable data structures between Git and JGit implementations. It sets environment variables, checks for prerequisites, defines testing functions, and runs a series of tests to compare behaviors and data consistency between the two systems.

methods.name: test_commit_jgit
methods.description: Creates a commit with JGit in a specified repository.

methods.name: test_same_refs
methods.description: Compares all references in the current repository between Git and JGit.

methods.name: test_same_ref
methods.description: Compares the rev-parse output of a specific reference between Git and JGit.

methods.name: test_same_reflog
methods.description: Compares reflogs of a reference between Git and JGit.
